title: Fitting Point Clouds with Iterated Transforms
description: An interactive TensorFlow.js lab that reverse-engineers an iterated function system from a target point cloud: a handful of affine transforms are enumerated to a fixed depth (commutative multisets via binary powers, or ordered words) and tuned by gradient descent against a symmetric Chamfer loss. Draw or load a target shape, pick the number of transforms and the depth, and watch a random constellation self-organize into the outline you asked for.
